description: Cross-exchange funding-rate spreads: predicted next funding for every perp on Hyperliquid, Binance and Bybit, normalised to an hourly and annualised rate, ranked by the gap between the highest and lowest venue, with which venue to short and which to long for a delta-neutral carry, plus Hyperliquid open interest and 24h volume as a liquidity check. Pass coin= for one market, or a minimum spread and open interest. $0.005. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

min_annualized.description: minimum spread in % per year, default 10

min_open_interest.description: minimum Hyperliquid open interest in USD, default 1000000

min_volume_24h.description: minimum Hyperliquid 24h volume in USD, default 250000
